provenance: Hand-written list for the Topic Desk (assets/js/page/topic-desk-model.js). Drafted by Claude on 2026-10-19 for Ian's review. Every other sentence on the desk is computed from the library's data. A dek states what a topic covers and asks the question the churches answer. It never states an answer, a tradition's position, or Mere Orthodoxy's position. A fault-line row is shown only when every quotation in it is found, word for word, in the article the library maps to the topic. A verse note is a plain textual fact.

de-scriptura.dek: What the church says about the Bible. Its authority, sufficiency, and interpretation.

de-deo.dek: What the church teaches about who God is and what God is like.

de-praedestinatione.dek: How the church has spoken of election and predestination: God's eternal purpose concerning human salvation.

de-creatione.dek: What the church confesses about God as the maker of heaven and earth.

de-providentia.dek: How the church speaks of God's care for all that he has made and his governing of it.

de-peccato.dek: What the church teaches about sin, its origin, and its effects.

de-christo.dek: The person and work of Jesus Christ. How the creeds, councils, and teachers describe them.

de-spiritu-sancto.dek: The person and work of the Holy Spirit. How the creeds, councils, and teachers describe them.

de-gratia.dek: What the church teaches about the grace of God and how it works in salvation.

de-fide.dek: What the church teaches about faith, its nature, and its place in salvation.

de-justificatione.dek: How the church has taught that sinners stand right before God: what justification is, and how it relates to faith and works.

de-sanctificatione.dek: What the church teaches about the making holy of believers and how it relates to justification.

de-ecclesia.dek: What the church teaches about the church: its nature, its marks, and its government.

de-sacramentis.dek: What the church teaches about the sacraments or ordinances. Their number, meaning, and effect.

de-baptismo.dek: What the church teaches about baptism: its meaning, its subjects, and its mode.

de-coena.dek: What the church teaches about the Lord's Supper or Eucharist: its meaning and the manner of Christ's presence.

de-novissimis.dek: What the church teaches about death, judgment, and the end of all things.

de-resurrectione.dek: What the church confesses about the resurrection of the body.
